name: Nemish S Shah
current_role: Co-founder, ENAM Holdings (manages treasury and proprietary capital); Governing Body member, FLAME University
profile: Mumbai investor who co-founded ENAM with Vallabh Bhanshali in 1984. ENAM began as a broking firm, then grew into a leading IPO investment bank. ENAM's banking and broking businesses were merged into Axis Bank. Shah now runs ENAM Holdings' treasury and long-term proprietary investing in Indian equities, using bottom-up fundamental research.
interesting_fact: He is widely credited with pioneering equity investment research in India. ENAM's investment banking arm went on to top India's IPO league tables.
deep_cut_fact: He earned a B.Com from Lala Lajpat Rai College (Mumbai University) in 1977. He reads Jain scriptures, follows cricket and loves music, and peers say his spirituality balances his investing.
notes: Very low public profile and no personal social media found. ENAM founders also set up FLAME University in Pune, which may be a warmer route in. No published office email found.
